package database

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Explicit owned-wrapper compiler overlays ONLY. No official driver/cache
// source is altered; these fixtures produce no real native claim/DB binding,
// service grant, pool/task/native Closed or resource-release authority.
func TestResidentStandardPendingOriginalConnectAllowsInspectionAndRefusesAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	if residentConnectProofMode != "pending" {
		t.Fatal("wrong explicit wrapper control mode")
	}
	o := standardConnectorFixture(t, ":memory:")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	type outcome struct {
		connection bool
		err        error
	}
	done := make(chan outcome, 1)
	go func() {
		connection, err := o.connector.Connect(ctx)
		if connection != nil {
			// This unit primitive called Connect directly, outside sql.DB. It
			// disposes ONLY its actual returned public fixture object, with no
			// claim of native/pool/task completion or product close fallback.
			err = errors.Join(err, connection.Close())
		}
		done <- outcome{connection != nil, err}
	}()
	var inspectJoined, admissionJoined <-chan struct{}
	// Cancellation is BEFORE entry into the official Connector.Connect. This
	// test does not claim to cancel a kernel-blocked SQLite open. Always release
	// and join original wrapper and observation/admission helpers before fixture
	// pool disposal, including a failed assertion.
	defer func() {
		cancel()
		close(residentConnectProofContinue)
		select {
		case result := <-done:
			if result.connection || !errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled) {
				t.Error("original pre-entry cancelled Connect outcome differs", result)
			}
		case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
			t.Error("original wrapper return still pending")
		}
		for _, joined := range []<-chan struct{}{inspectJoined, admissionJoined} {
			if joined == nil {
				continue
			}
			select {
			case <-joined:
			case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
				t.Error("original fixture observer/admission helper still pending")
			}
		}
	}()
	select {
	case <-residentConnectProofReached:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("original registered public Connect pause not reached")
	}
	inspected := make(chan ResidentDatabaseInspection, 1)
	inspectDone := make(chan struct{})
	inspectJoined = inspectDone
	go func() { defer close(inspectDone); inspected <- o.InspectOriginal() }()
	select {
	case seen := <-inspected:
		if !seen.PoolRetained || !seen.Connector.ConnectAttempted || !seen.Connector.ConnectPending || seen.Connector.ConnectAbnormal || !seen.Connector.PrivateNativeStateOpaque || seen.Close.NativeOutcome != "unknown" {
			t.Fatal("pending original public Connect custody hidden", seen)
		}
	case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
		t.Fatal("inspection blocked behind original public Connect")
	}
	refused := make(chan error, 1)
	admissionDone := make(chan struct{})
	admissionJoined = admissionDone
	go func() {
		defer close(admissionDone)
		_, err := o.connector.Connect(t.Context())
		refused <- err
	}()
	select {
	case err := <-refused:
		if !errors.Is(err, ErrResidentConnectionAttempted) {
			t.Fatal("pending original admitted replacement Connect", err)
		}
	case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
		t.Fatal("replacement admission blocked behind original public Connect")
	}
}

func assertOriginalConnectAbnormalRetained(t *testing.T, o *ResidentOpen, expected any) {
	t.Helper()
	seen := o.InspectOriginal()
	original := o.connect
	if original == nil || !original.abnormal || original.finished || original.cause != expected || original.resultErr == nil || seen.FirstError != original.resultErr || !seen.Connector.ConnectPending || !seen.Connector.ConnectAbnormal || seen.Connector.FirstConnectError != original.resultErr || !seen.Connector.PrivateNativeStateOpaque || seen.Close.NativeOutcome != "unknown" {
		t.Fatal("original public Connect abnormal state was forgotten", seen)
	}
	if _, err := o.connector.Connect(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, ErrResidentConnectionAttempted) {
		t.Fatal("abnormal original admitted a new physical attempt", err)
	}
	if o.connect != original {
		t.Fatal("abnormal original call object replaced")
	}
}

func TestResidentStandardOriginalConnectPanicRetainsCauseAndRefusesAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	if residentConnectProofMode != "panic" {
		t.Fatal("wrong explicit wrapper control mode")
	}
	o := standardConnectorFixture(t, ":memory:")
	var cause any
	func() {
		defer func() { cause = recover() }()
		_, _ = o.connector.Connect(t.Context())
	}()
	if cause != "original public Connect fixture panic" {
		t.Fatal("owned original wrapper panic did not run", cause)
	}
	assertOriginalConnectAbnormalRetained(t, o, cause)
}

func TestResidentStandardOriginalConnectGoexitRetainsCallAndRefusesAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	if residentConnectProofMode != "goexit" {
		t.Fatal("wrong explicit wrapper control mode")
	}
	o := standardConnectorFixture(t, ":memory:")
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { defer close(done); _, _ = o.connector.Connect(t.Context()) }()
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal("original wrapper Goexit goroutine did not end")
	}
	assertOriginalConnectAbnormalRetained(t, o, nil)
}
